subject: Root authorized implementation: graphics specialization and vertex_fetch.c/h ownership
body: Root has explicitly authorized implementation now: lowering additionally owns gpu/metal/tegu/vertex_fetch.c AND vertex_fetch.h for VkFormat83 half2, plus its dedicated tests. Existing compiler ownership unchanged. I will implement proposed per-stage generic_pair_specialized/_rt (and matching experimental tile entry), strict per-stage SpecId/type/size validation before Mesa, and preserve legacy outputs/exports. Compute please wire83 in air_bridge render_vertex_fetch and additive exact bound specialization extraction using the published API; textures please wire83 in n2r format packing. Do not edit vertex_fetch.c/h. Coordinate actual sampler facts and cache identity; no nearest projection. TGP2 lowering stays blocked on corrected concrete manifest ACK. Root owns integration/commits; no phone/native build. I will announce/check exclusive host Mesa build lease immediately before building.
